title: path_cost infinity handling is implicit, not explicit
description: At line 172, the check `if link_cost.is_nan() || link_cost < 0.0` does not explicitly handle positive infinity. When link_etx * mhri overflows to f32::INFINITY, the check passes, and Rust saturates the cast to u16::MAX. Code works correctly but relies on implicit saturation behavior. Should use `!link_cost.is_finite()` for clarity.
close_reason: Fixed: changed is_nan() || link_cost < 0.0 to !link_cost.is_finite() || link_cost < 0.0 for explicit handling of infinity
